intro.zh: 每页换一种柔和的粉彩底色，标题居中，白色圆角卡片配深色描边和错位投影，角落点缀圆形拼成的小花；适合课堂、亲子、社区活动和轻松的团队分享。
intro.en: A new pastel canvas on each page, centred titles, rounded white cards with dark outlines and offset shadows, circle flowers in the corners; for classrooms, community sessions and friendly kickoffs.
intro.ja: ページごとに変わるパステルの背景、中央揃えの見出し、濃い縁取りとずらした影の白い角丸カード、隅に円で描いた小花。授業、親子・地域イベント、気軽なチーム共有向け。

routing.avoid: Audiences that expect authority and precision: board reviews, academic defences, dense technical material.

recipe.composition: Centred rounded-sans titles on a pastel canvas that changes page by page (cream, turquoise, pink, butter, lavender, mint, peach, sky); circle-built daisies and coloured dots sit in the corners, away from the text.
recipe.components: Rounded white cards with a dark outline and a solid offset shadow; pastel step blocks in the same outline language; quotes sit in one large white card. Keep text short and friendly.
recipe.narrative: Welcome, the week at a glance, schedule, activity chart, focus areas, quote, team, how it works, topic split.
recipe.nativeCoverage: Cover, list, card rows, step blocks, bar and pie charts, quote card and team cards as native text, shapes and charts. Not reproduced: the hand-drawn SVG daisies, stars, clouds, rainbows and smiling suns (replaced by circle flowers and dots), white titles with dark text shadow, Fredoka One and Quicksand, avatar illustrations, coloured header strips on cards.

pageMapping.differences: Hand-drawn SVG daisies and stars become circle-built flowers and dots; a butter badge holds the kicker.
Source list sits inside a white outlined card with a mint header strip and yellow bullet dots; native is a centred title with an open bullet list. Sun, star and rainbow drawings are not reproduced.
Five weekday columns with coloured header strips become a row of three plain white outlined cards; the white title with dark shadow is drawn dark.
A vertical stack of five rows with numbered colour circles becomes one horizontal row of numbered pastel blocks; cloud drawings are not reproduced.
Source chart is inside a white outlined card with a different colour and outline per bar; native is an editable chart on the canvas in one series colour.
A two-by-two grid with lettered colour badges becomes one row of three cards without badges.
Rainbow and star drawings are replaced by circle flowers and dots.
Round avatar illustrations with names below become white outlined name cards without pictures.
Numbered colour circles joined by arrows become numbered pastel blocks without arrows.
Source is a ring chart with a total in the centre beside a title and legend; native is a pie chart under a centred page title.
